info.name: mira-journey
info.description:
# MIRA Journey Module API Collection

Full Postman API documentation and endpoints for the **Journey** module (`/api/v1/journeys`).

---

## 📚 Enums & Acceptable Values

### 1. JourneyType (`journeyType` array)
- `PRIVATE_JOURNEY`
- `SELF_DRIVE_JOURNEY`
- `SMALL_GROUP`
- `LUXURY_ESCAPE`
- `FAMILY_JOURNEY`
- `SIGNATURE_JOURNEY`

### 2. TravelStyle (`travelStyle` array)
- `CULTURE_HERITAGE`
- `NATURE`
- `ADVENTURE`
- `FOOD_WINE`
- `COASTAL_ESCAPE`
- `MOUNTAINS`
- `SLOW_TRAVEL`
- `LUXURY`
- `PHOTOGRAPHY`
- `WELLNESS`

### 3. PerfectFor (`perfectFor` array)
- `COUPLES`
- `FAMILIES`
- `FRIENDS`
- `FOOD_WINE`
- `SOLO_TRAVELLERS`
- `HONEYMOONERS`
- `FIRST_TIME_VISITORS`
- `RETURNING_VISITORS`
- `NATURE_LOVERS`
- `ADVENTURE_SEEKERS`

### 4. Pace (`pace` string)
- `RELAXED`
- `BALANCED`
- `ACTIVE`

### 5. ComfortLevel (`comfortLevel` string)
- `COMFORT`
- `BOUTIQUE`
- `PREMIUM_LUXURY`

### 6. JourneyStatus (`status` string)
- `DRAFT`
- `PUBLISHED`
- `ARCHIVED`

query.description: Search keyword for title, subtitle or slug
Comma-separated or array of JourneyType enums: PRIVATE_JOURNEY, SELF_DRIVE_JOURNEY, SMALL_GROUP, LUXURY_ESCAPE, FAMILY_JOURNEY, SIGNATURE_JOURNEY
Comma-separated or array of TravelStyle enums: CULTURE_HERITAGE, NATURE, ADVENTURE, FOOD_WINE, COASTAL_ESCAPE, MOUNTAINS, SLOW_TRAVEL, LUXURY, PHOTOGRAPHY, WELLNESS
Comma-separated or array of PerfectFor enums: COUPLES, FAMILIES, FRIENDS, FOOD_WINE, SOLO_TRAVELLERS, HONEYMOONERS, FIRST_TIME_VISITORS, RETURNING_VISITORS, NATURE_LOVERS, ADVENTURE_SEEKERS

request.description: Fetches paginated list of journeys with flexible multi-enum filtering, price range, duration, and full text search.
Fetches a single journey record by slug.
Fetches a single journey record by CUID.

Creates a new Journey record. Accepts all enum types (`SIGNATURE_JOURNEY`, `PRIVATE_JOURNEY`, `CULTURE_HERITAGE`, `COUPLES`, `BALANCED`, `PREMIUM_LUXURY`, `PUBLISHED`, etc.) and structured JSON sections.
Updates an existing Journey record specified by `id` parameter.
